crossRefs.note: “You shall command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp…
“Also take fine spices: of liquid myrrh, five hundred shekels; and of fragrant cinnamon half as much, even two hundred…
the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the basin with its base.

parallels.note: “The duty of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be the oil for the light, the sweet incense, the continual meal…

translations.web: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense,
translations.bsb: olive oil for the light; spices for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense;
translations.kjv: And oil for the light, and spices for anointing oil, and for the sweet incense,
